verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a broad set of official SDKs. They include a Node package on GitHub with automatic retries and exponential backoff, a Python SDK with an async client, and iOS and Rust SDKs with typed models, PKCE and pagination helpers. There are also framework SDKs for Next.js, React, Astro, TanStack Start, Laravel and plain JS, plus a published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the SDKs' quality in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the package with: npm install @workos-inc/node

The SDK automatically retries requests that fail with a transient error — a network error, a request timeout (408), a rate limit (429), or a server error (500, 502, 503, 504) — using exponential backoff with jitter.
Every HTTP API method has an identical async counterpart on `AsyncWorkOSClient`.
It includes public-client helpers for native authentication with PKCE, async API clients, typed models and errors, automatic retries, and pagination helpers.

The AuthKit Next.js SDK provides server-side and client-side utilities for integrating AuthKit authentication into Next.js applications.
